spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (वृश्यति)
To choose, to prefer or select.

m. (-शः)
1 A rat.
2 A flower, (Justicia ganderussa.)
f. (-शा)
A drug.
n. (-शं)
Ginger.
E.
वृ to choose, शक् Uṇādi aff.; also वृष.

(उ) वृषु r. 1st cl. (वर्षति)
1 To sprinkle.
2 To hurt or kill.
3 To weary.
4 To give.
r. 10th cl. (वर्षयति-ते)
1 To conceive, to be impregnated.
2 To possess supreme or supernatural power.
3 To be powerful.

m. (-षः)
1 A bull.
2 The sign of the zodiac

Taurus.
3

Virtue, moral merit.
4 Virtue personified, as a bull or the bull of Ś

IVA.
5

A man of a lecherous disposition, one of the four descriptions into which men are divided in erotic works.
6 A rat.
7 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha.
8 A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.)
9 (In composition,) Excellent, pre-eminent.
10 A name of KARṆ
VIṢṆ

An enemy, an adversary.
13 Particular ground, judged proper for the foundation of a house.
14 Love or

KĀMA.
15

A strong or athletic man.
n. (-षं)
A peacock's plumage or tail.
f. (-षा)
1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) []
2 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
f. (-षी)
The seat of the religious student or one used by ascetics, formed of Kusa grass.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
1 A scorpion.
2 The sign

Scorpio.
3

A hairy caterpillar.
4 A crab.
5 A sort of beetle found in cow-dung.
6 A centipede.
7 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.)
8 The month when the sun is in Scorpio.
f. (-का)
A potherb, (Basella.)
E.
व्रश्च to cut, Uṇādi aff. किकन्, and the semivowel changed to the vowel.

f. (-या)
A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.)
E.
वृश्चिक a scorpion, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-ली)
1 A line of scorpions.
2 A shrub, (Tragia involucrata.)
E.
वृश्चिक a scorpion, and आली a line.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant.

m. (-णः)
The testicles or scrotum.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, (seminal fluid,) aff. क्यु or युच्.

f. (-च्छूः)
Ulceration of the scrotum.
E.
वृषण, and कच्छू a root.

m. (-श्वः)
The horse of INDRA.
E.
वृषन् INDRA, and अश्व the horse.

n. (-सुः)
The treasure of INDRA.
E.
वृषन् INDRA, and वसु wealth.

m. (-कः)
A cat.
E.
वृष a rat, and दंशक devourer.

IVA.
2
GAṆ

EŚA.
3

A virtuous man.
E.
वृष a bull, a rat, or virtue, and ध्वज emblem.

m. (-षा)
1 INDRA, as god of the firmament.
2 KARṆA, the hero.
3 Pain, sorrow.
4 Insensibility from extreme pain.
5 A bull.
6 A horse.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.

m. (-नः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Vireng, (Embelia ribes).
E.
वृष a bull, and नाशन destroying.

IVA.
2

A bull set at liberty.
E.
वृष a bull, and पति lord.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
वृष a rat, and पर्ण a leaf; fem. aff. ङीष्.

IVA.
2

A demon.
3 A wasp.
4 A sort of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)
E.
वृष a bull, &c., पर्वन् a joint.

m. (-भः)
1 A bull.
2 (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent.
3 The orifice of the ear.
4 An elephant's ear.
5 A drug; also Ṛṣabha, described as a root resembling the horn of a bull, brought from the Himālaya mountains, of cooling and tonic properties, and serviceable in catarrh and consumption.
6 The first of the Jaina pontiffs of the present era.
f. (-भी)
1 A widow.
2 Cowach.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अभच्.

m. (-तिः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वृषभ a bull, and गति going.

m. (-जः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वृषभ a bull, and ध्वज emblem.

f. (-सा)
The capital of INDRA, and the immortals.
E.
वृष the bull of ŚIVA, भास् splendour, and टाप् added.

m. (-यः)
An asylum, a place of refuge or shelter.
E.
वृ to screen, Uṇādi aff. कयन्, and षुक् augment.

m. (-लः)
1 A horse.
2 A Śūdra, or man of the servile tribe.
3 The sovereign

CANDRAGUPTA.
4

Garlick.
5

A sinner, a reprobate, a wicked or unrighteous man.
f. (-ली)
1 A girl twelve years old, in whom menstruation has commenced, and who is unmarried.
2 A barren woman.
3 A woman during menstruation.
4 The mother of a still-born child.
5 A woman of a low caste.
E.
वृष a bull, or virtue, &c., and ल to take, aff. क, or वृष to sprinkle, कल Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्वं)
The condition or state of a Śūdra.
E.
त्व added to वृषल.

m. (-जः)
The son of a reprobate.
E.
वृषल a wicked man, and आत्मज son.

n. (-नं)
Intercourse with a Śūdra female.
E.
वृषली, and सेवन frequenting.

m. (-नः)
A rat.
E.
वृष a bull, and लोचन the eye.

m. (-नः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वृष a bull, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-त्रुः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
वृष KARṆA, and शत्रु the enemy.

f. (-क्की)
A wasp.

f. (-न्ती)
1 A lascivious woman.
2 A cow in heat.
E.
वृष a man of a particular class, or a bull, forming with the increments सुक्, and क्यच a nominal verb, implying desire of such a man, &c. participial aff. of the present tense शतृ, fem. aff. ङीष्.

f. (-यी)
1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
2 GAURĪ.
3 SVĀHĀ, the wife of

AGNI.
4
ŚACI, the wife of

INDRA.
5

A shrub, (Asparagus racemosus.)
6 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
वृषाकपि VIṢṆU, &c., ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.

m. (-पिः)
1 KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆ
Ś

IVA.
3

AGNI, or fire.
E.
वृष virtue, अ not, कपि to shake or agitate, इ aff., and the radical augment rejected; or वृषा INDRA, अकपि untrembling, as before; or वृष virtue, or वृषा INDRA, and कपि an ape, being the ape as it were of the greater gods: other etymologies occur.

IVA.
2

A pious man.
3 Marking-nut plant.
4 An eunuch, one employed in the Zenana.
E.
वृष the bull of the deity, or virtue, and अङ्क mark.

m. (-जः)
A very small drum, held in one hand, and played by means of a string attached to it.
E.
वृषाङ्क ŚIVA, and ज born, made.

m. (-नः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वृष a bull, and अञ्चन going.

m. (-कः)
A form of ŚIVA.
E.
वृष a bull, अन to be, and कन् aff.

m. (-कः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
वृष virtue, अन्त end, and कन् aff.

m. (-णः)
A sparrow.

m. (-रः)
A cat.
E.
वृष a rat, and आहार food.

m. (-षी)
A peacock.
E.
वृष his plumage, and इनि aff.

f. (-षी)
The seat or cushion of an ascetic; also वृसी.

m. (-र्गः)
Setting a bull at liberty on occasion of a sacrifice or obsequial oblation.
E.
वृष, and उत्सर्ग letting loose.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Rain.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Raining, sprinkling.
E.
वृष्टि, and कर what makes.

m. (-लः)
The rainy season.
E.
वृष्टि, and काल time.

f. (-घ्नी)
Guzeratty cardamoms.
E.
वृष्टि rain, and घ्न destructive, fem. form.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Nourished or watered by rain.
E.
वृष्टि rain, जीवन living.

m. (-भूः)
A frog.
E.
वृष्टि rain, and भू being, or being born.

mfn. (-मात्-मती-मत्)
Rainy, full of rain.
m. (-मान्)
A cloud.
E.
वृष्टि, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णिः-ष्णिः-ष्णि)
1 Heretical, heterodox.
2 Angry, passionate.
m. (-ष्णिः)
1 A ram.
2 One of the descendants of

YADU.
3
VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆ

A heretic, a sectary.
5 A ray of light.
6

INDRA.
7

AGNI.
8

Air or wind.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. नि, and the vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
1 Errhine, aphrodisiac, provocative, (food or medicine.)
2 To be sprinkled or aspersed.
m. (-ष्यः)
Kidneybean, (Phaseolus radiatus).
f. (-ष्या)
A drug, commonly Ridādhi.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्यप्.

f. (-न्धा)
A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
